19. INSTALL TIE ROD ENDS
(a) Screw the tie rod ends onto the rack ends until the matchmarks are aligned.
(b) After adjusting toe-in, torque the clamp nuts.

20. INSTALL RIGHT AND LEFT TURN PRESSURE TUBES
(a) Install new four union seats.

(b) Using SST, install and torque the tubes.
SST 09633-00020
Torque:
Valve housing side 200 kg-cm (14 ft-lb, 20 N-m)
Rack housing side 240 kg-cm (17 ft-lb, 24 N-m)
HINT: Use a torque wrench with a fulcrum length of 300 mm (11.81 in.).
